---
title: MDEA phase searches at the slope-bound endpoint
---

The measured searches found 80 descents across 27 distinct feeds and no descent in 1,484 finite searches. Liquid plus a vapor-connected phase lowers Gibbs energy at all 27 feeds. The qualified model bubble pressure exceeds the imposed pressure in every comparison. The search outcomes are model predictions at the declared conditions. The paired errors estimate numerical uncertainty in the Gibbs difference. Independent review and manuscript promotion are pending.

The march established domain membership for 6,352 searches inside the 5.0367 MPa bubble-pressure interval and 2,312 searches above a retained cutoff. The warm start from the lowest loading failed on 57 paths, leaving 1,596 grid searches without membership. The grid outcome counts are held.
